source: Fictional allotment association (koloniförening) board meeting written for Task Q fix round 1 as the HARD fixture (scripts/notes-eval.ts): ASR-like transcript (lower case, misheard names, cut-off lines, cross-talk), an interleaved topic, a decision reversed ~5 minutes later and a hedge that firms up. Fictional association and people; no real meeting.
traps: Decided, then reversed: 'Tjugoåttatusen, vi köper åkgräsklipparen från maskinfirman. Klart.' (01:36) is a real decision and Göran commits to ordering it; at 06:16–06:32 a second quote is coming and the chair strikes the decision ('Då stryker vi beslutet') and moves it to the next meeting. From then on no decision may say the mower is bought (only reversed/deferred), and the order action must go. Must be fixed within one tick of the reversal.
Hedge that firms up: Reza 'skulle kanske kunna titta på vattenledningen, jag vet inte riktigt', the chair asks 'så kan du titta på det?', Reza 'okej, ja' — a real action for Reza.
Hedge that stays hedged: Johanna 'jag kanske frågar min granne om släpkärran, vi får se' (not an action).
Already done: the chair has already called the locksmith (not an action). Johanna found the key (not an action).
ASR noise: speakers say 'Göran Lija', 'Johana', 'Resa Tehrani'; the speaker map has the right names, owners must use them.
Cross-talk and cut-off lines ('ja men alltså om vi', 'jag har en fråga om'); an interleaved topic (the fence raised during the water item, handled later).
Ideas without a decision: compost rules (newsletter), an information evening for the queue ('kanske i höst').
